this is a candidate; sealing follows adoption

known_limitations: The 'ai' per-cell state tiles are produced here by ONE contiguous run, whereas the vintage of record's ai tiles sit on four distinct grids across the dateline (built over separate runs). The aggregates are comparable; the per-cell tile structure is not.
Risk percentile tables were rebuilt from this series' own distribution (frozen mode), so they are not comparable row-for-row with the vintage's risk tables.
Monthly series here are calendar-month means of the daily series, keyed on date as YYYY-MM-01, matching the vintage's convention.
interpolation_not_used: All 8 days were obtained as REAL observations from NCEI. No value in this candidate is interpolated. The interpolation fallback was validated (73,360 held-out cell-days, SST MAE 0.067 degC, exceedance agreement 98.8%) but was not needed.
